q: Ornstein's isomorphism theorem (1970) states that two Bernoulli shifts with the same entropy are:
exp: Ornstein's theorem: entropy is a complete invariant for Bernoulli shifts. Any two Bernoulli shifts with the same entropy are measurably isomorphic. This was a landmark result—entropy had been shown to distinguish Bernoulli shifts (Kolmogorov), Ornstein showed it is the only obstruction.
